name: 36502 · Atmore, AL
findings: ZIP 36502 (Atmore) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 12 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36502 (Atmore) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
